data.body: **[P2] Do not recreate a parent that history already marks complete.** `endedOperationIds` only covers the current invocation, while `hasAbandonedParent` ignores a direct terminal context. If an unawaited callback completes in a later invocation after its child context completed, this fallback parents it to that already-ended span, producing invalid temporal containment. Use the operation history and timestamps to fall back to `Workflow` when the completion follows a terminal parent, and add a cross-invocation regression test.
